task: Refine the canonical Shoperation Alap / Pro / Add-on capability matrix from accepted Shopify, Shoprenter and UNAS benchmark decisions without changing runtime behavior.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Package entitlements are commercial and authorization-facing roadmap authority. The change must preserve accepted competitor-benchmark boundaries and prevent Digital Office leakage into Alap.

acceptanceCriteria: Alap remains a complete professional webshop and is not artificially crippled below the accepted Shopify/Shoprenter/UNAS benchmark baseline.
Digital Office and all of its collaboration/workforce surfaces are Pro-only except ordinary transactional webshop email and Form Wizard notification behavior.
Previously accepted Alap multi-location inventory and simple event-to-action automation remain Alap; advanced routing/workflow depth remains Pro.
Specialized or variable-cost capabilities remain Add-on/post-launch rather than being forced into Pro merely to increase package count.
invariants: All 42 templates and the full manual Builder are available in both Alap and Pro.
Core checkout/order/payment/shipping/invoice/tax/security authorities cannot be paywalled behind Pro.
Digital Office Team Chat, mailbox/team inbox, tasks, approvals, staff profiles, leave/delegation, sending center, communication workspace and related workforce tooling do not leak into Alap.
Company billing in B2C checkout is not the same as Pro B2B organizational purchasing.

failureModes: A later assistant recommendation overwrites an earlier explicit PO package decision.
Digital Office subfeatures leak into Alap through generic chat/email/workforce labels.
Basic merchant security, reporting or inventory operations are over-paywalled despite the accepted competitor benchmark.
A specialized add-on is incorrectly treated as mandatory Pro scope.
edgeCases: Simple customer groups exist in Alap while full company-account B2B governance remains Pro.
Multi-location stock is Alap while automated cross-location routing/split fulfillment is Pro.
Simple event-to-action recipes are Alap while branching multi-step workflows are Pro.
Transactional and campaign email can exist outside Digital Office without creating an inbox/team-workspace entitlement leak.

alternatives.summary: Use the accepted competitor benchmark plus later PO overrides to define a complete Alap and operational Pro boundary.
alternatives.reason: It preserves prior work, prevents arbitrary paywalls, and keeps Pro focused on business-system depth.

alternatives.summary: Keep the earlier simplified matrix that put all multi-location and automation depth into Pro.
alternatives.reason: It contradicts earlier explicit PO decisions and loses information from the detailed benchmark conversations.

challenge.scenario: An Alap customer needs two warehouses and manual transfer visibility but no automation.
challenge.finding: Earlier PO decision explicitly placed baseline multi-location/multi-warehouse inventory in Alap.
challenge.resolution: Keep locations, per-location stock and manual inventory operations in Alap; reserve automated routing/split optimization for Pro.

challenge.scenario: An Alap merchant uses normal order emails, forms, newsletter or simple campaign messages.
challenge.finding: These do not make the merchant a Digital Office customer.
challenge.resolution: Keep transactional/form/basic marketing communication in Alap while every shared inbox, Team Chat and workforce collaboration surface remains Pro-only.

specialistReviews.finding: Entitlements must split by business capability, not by duplicated runtime or template implementation.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep shared engines canonical and package-gate capabilities server-side.

specialistReviews.finding: The accepted benchmark strategy is Alap = complete professional webshop, Pro = larger-team/business-system depth.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use competitor baseline as a floor, then monetize higher operational complexity and specialized add-ons rather than ordinary commerce.

proofPlan: Assert the structured package matrix contains the accepted Alap multi-location and simple automation boundaries.
Assert every Digital Office collaboration/workforce capability is absent from Alap and present in Pro.
Assert full Builder and 42 template family access remain shared.
Run canonical quality tests, TypeScript and production build on exact head.

requirements.requirement: The canonical roadmap package matrix reflects accepted Alap, Pro and Add-on boundaries from the Shopify, Shoprenter and UNAS benchmark plus later PO overrides.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Digital Office collaboration/workforce capabilities must not be assigned to Alap.
Baseline multi-location inventory must not become Pro-only.

notes: Package-authority refinement only. No runtime entitlement implementation or billing/pricing changes are introduced in this transaction.
